services.title: Collision repair
services.body: Body panels are straightened, replaced and refinished to match the factory line.

reviews.author: Luis Angel Moreno
reviews.text: Great service and great quality repairs. My left fender had to be replaced, front bumper repaired and other needed blends were down perfectly. I am truly happy with their work and service.

reviews.author: Dan Chiquito
reviews.text: The best auto body in the area. You can trust them with your auto body needs. They helped me with repairs I needed on a car that had some rust after a road hazard damaged the paint. Other auto bodies quoted me to sand and repaint. They were the only ones who offered to weld a replacement part to prevent the rust from returning. The paint job after was immaculate. Looked brand new. Additionally, my other vehicle got some minor scratches from an incident. I took it to them to have the scratches buffed out. They helped me free of charge. These are nice, trustworthy folks here who take care of their customers and community.

reviews.author: Matt Stoly
reviews.text: Exceptional service. Went here to fix my new Audi. They did an exceptional job. Paint matched better than OEM. Full repairs completed promptly. Can’t recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Trinae H.
reviews.text: 2025 update: unfortunately I needed them again. While dealing with my insurance company and a hit and run driver fighting my case for months!! They showed compassion, patience, and worked with me to get my car back on the road. They went above and beyond getting my car back like new again. I will FOREVER use them and recommend them. I dropped my car off on a Sunday not expecting anyone to be there. Of course Alex was and he went over my whole car with me and pointed out damages I didn't even see. Thanks again Alex + team! 2023: I want to thank everyone over at Bloomfield auto body for the amazing job that they did on my car. They went above and beyond to fix the damage from a deer and any other imperfections they noticed they fixed with no hesitations. I was surprisingly surprised getting my car back seeing it detailed and then letting me know that they notice a couple things and they went ahead and fixed that as well. Also, you need an appointment to do an inspection of the vehicle. However when I walked in they accommodated me which I appreciated as I was as well. If you ever need any work done I highly recommend. Hopefully I don't need any work done in the future but if I do I will be back.

reviews.author: Ezequiel Santiago
reviews.text: My SUV IS NEW and was stolen and wrecked and I chose this body shop for the repairs. When they were done it came out better then when I drove it off the lot . I highly recommend this shop. I was broken from my experience. They made me feel great again with the work that they did. I am posting before and after pictures off my vehicle along with new pictures of this great great shpp. This month of may 2021 I was driving to Connecticut for recert training when a giant dear ran in front of my truck. The was okay and angry but was able to run away. My truck took in front passenger side damage but luckily no airbag deployed. My insurance company put me back in the great hands of these professionals. Again they came to the rescue. The owner remembered me which impressed me alot. He and his crew went to work quickly and restored my truck I once again. I just love getting treated like a preferred customer even if I'm not. But that is what you get at this shop. They explain everything and treat you like a primer gold card customer. Thank you guys once again for getting back on the road and feeling great about the service I received.

reviews.author: albert koodray
reviews.text: Alexander and his team did an amazing job on my 2025 e350. Fast , meticulous and as if it was out of showroom. Would only take my auto to them. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Ben Fuchs
reviews.text: A Certified State Farm Shop. 2023 Nissan kicks S , Black After snow storm I discovered tire marks on cars body, Brought it to Alex. Great educational experience and communication. Car looks Luxurious n New, amazing wax .

reviews.author: Darya Makarova
reviews.text: I went here after my bumper was hit and was just hanging there. The body shop is great, very accommodating with time, great at communicating with the customer. Everyone is friendly and really down-to-earth. Great service all around. Thank you for your help

reviews.author: Chana Ruder
reviews.text: Got my Subaru fixed at Bloomfield Auto body after a rear accident. Alex was super friendly and guided me throughout the entire process. The quality of the work was amazing and I definitely would recommend Bloomfield Auto Body for any automotive repairs

reviews.author: Madam Entre
reviews.text: Went in for an issue with my tail light and they took care of me. Most body shops try to exaggerate the problem to overcharge you but they are actually honest. If I need body work in the future, I will come back here. Fair, friendly and quality work. Thank you Alex.

reviews.author: Karyn Murphy
reviews.text: Great service both times I have had work done by Bloomfield Auto Body on Broad Street. I highly recommend them if you want quality work done at a fair price. So glad I found this business, they're a pleasure to deal with.

reviews.author: Patricia Seale
reviews.text: Please use Bloomfield Auto Body for any car service they provide! This business is professional, responsive, honest, and look out for their customers - a true breath of fresh air and wonderful, customer oriented service - especially these days! Went there for advice about damage I caused, and not only got advice, but my car was immediately looked at by Imman, magically cleaned up (no charge) by Alexander, AND I was given a quote for a complete repair in no time at all! Their kindness and professionalism is unparalleled! Go to Bloomfield Auto Body!

reviews.author: Vishal Sundaram
reviews.text: Got work done on my Porsche 911 at Bloomfield Auto Body. Alex the manager was helpful throughout the entire process. Fantastic and careful work. Very trusting and will be going back here.

reviews.author: Rita Z
reviews.text: I had my 2018 Lexus NX 300 dropped off at Bloomfield auto body after getting hit on the right side. They did great work and brought the car back in amazing condition! The whole team is very communicative and I would definitely recommend anyone to use their shop for body repairs!

reviews.author: chandra sekar
reviews.text: I had scratches on my Porsche Cayenne by the bumper. I stopped by this shop. The owner immediately started working on to remove the bruises. He was able to bring the damaged area within 10 minutes. Looks new now. AMAZING JOB! The best part is he did not charge for it. He is sincere and honest. I highly recommend this shop. I saved $$$ Next time I will not even bother to shop around others. THANK YOU!!!

reviews.author: Angelo D’Andrea
reviews.text: Simply put, the team at Bloomfield Auto body is thorough and professional ensuring the customer is satisfied during every step of the process. I had my car repaired after an accident and after a long repair my car looked brand new. The team went above and beyond to have every detail precisely fixed as if nothing happened to the car. They are genuine people who operate a respectable business. Could not recommend them enough. Amazing service!!

reviews.author: Genia Morse
reviews.text: My name is Genia Morse and this is my second review, I picked up my Encore from Bloomfield Body Shop and there are no words to describe the beautiful job they did, not only was the work Superior, but my Encore was detailed to the max. There are just absolutely no way to tell this Shop and everyone that is a part of this great place I am eternally grateful and THANK U, THANK U SO VERY, VERY MUCH!!

reviews.author: Nick D.
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of using Bloomfield Auto Body twice over the past year. One to replace a damaged door on our CR-V and the other to repaint a badly damaged bumper on our Subaru which had the unfortunate close encounter with a retaining wall. Suffice to say that Alex and his team were amazing to deal with. From start to finish they put as at ease on how the process worked. They were professional, knowledgeable, patient and understanding, which I feel is hard to find these days. They also went above and beyond by fixing a few things that we weren't aware like deep scratches and rust spots, free of charge. Finally, they even took the time to detail our vehicles and make them shine as if they were new! All this to say, I'm happy to have a found a great local body shop that listens and caters to their customers needs. Looking forward in using Alex and his team again.

reviews.author: Susanne Fedder
reviews.text: Sadly, my car was totaled and they never had a chance to work on it. I hear their work is amazing. However, I can judge them on their kind hearts and professionalism as they guided me through the process. They made an otherwise terrifying ordeal feel less awful. I'm forever grateful.

reviews.author: Yuting Lin
reviews.text: My car's side door handle was broken while the interior handle was locked, leaving the door completely inaccessible. While other auto body shops quoted me several hours of labor to re-open the door, the staff at Bloomfield Auto Body quickly resolved the issue in just a minute using a specialized hook, and they didn't charge me a dime! I wasn't a paying customer at the time, but I deeply appreciate their genuine assistance and support.

reviews.author: Dee M
reviews.text: Took my Subaru here after damaging my wheel & suspension. The folks at Bloomfield Auto Body were helpful and thorough from my very first call requesting tow service, up until final delivery of my repaired (and sparkling!) vehicle. You can tell that Alexander is an involved owner, who didn't mind explaining the details behind what was happening & their approach to the repairs. They were also responsive given that I didn't have a vehicle during the time my SUV was in their shop. Will definitely come back if I need any more work done on my baby!

reviews.author: phil riccardi
reviews.text: Great auto body shop. I had a side mirror replaced. Not only was the job done well but I noticed when I got home they also buffed out a small scratch that was on the door. I would recommend getting any work done there. Another surprise how they returned my car cleaner then when it comes back from the car wash that I use. The staff was great.

reviews.author: Rafi Bromberg
reviews.text: Excellent service. Friendly staff and proactive about keeping me informed throughout the repair process. They repaired the damage to my car and left it in better condition than it was before. They handled all the dealings with my insurance company and made sure everything I needed was covered by insurance. I only paid my deductible, and they included several extra services at no extra cost. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Mehmet Yazici
reviews.text: BE AWARE **** Estimated $7,000 and some parts they want to replace are still working. Went to another auto body and they offered about $2,000 for the same fix. This place is a SCAM.

reviews.author: Catherine Outlaw
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience! The office and shop is very clean and organized. The staff very helpful, knowledgeable and professional. The work was performed in a timely manner. My car looks several years newer than its age. I’m very impressed with the outcome. I absolutely recommend Bloomfield Auto Body.

reviews.author: Slava Greenberg
reviews.text: I got my Lexus fixed at Bloomfield Auto body after a rear end accident. They did a fantastic job and even detailed the car afterwards. They finished the car in a week and it looks better than before. Definitely would recommend!

reviews.author: Magali Velez
reviews.text: This shop was recommended to me by my Auto Insurance company and they didn't disappoint. Alex and Nora (married) were both exceptionally good with info, updating me and quality of work. I am happy they are in my town. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Maria Pannullo
reviews.text: I want to thank Bloomfield Auto Body not once but 2x for the beautiful work they did with my truck. Not only did they repair they outside of it. They checked everything from breaks to balancing tires to make sure my family and I were safe. Thank you again.

reviews.author: Murat Mamkegh
reviews.text: Imman was so helpful and reliable!! A neighbor backed up into my car and left some bumper damage that their insurance wanted to pay off. He took one look at the damage and knew they were underselling the estimates of how much repairs would be significantly! He guided me on every step to take and even when the insurance reached out to say they couldn't come to an agreement, he told me to ignore them and that he would take care of it. True to his word, Bloomfield Auto Body did a full replacement of the bumper and relating components with detailing and all and I never had to pay a single penny out of pocket. They were timely and communicated with me every step of the way. Thank you, especially, to Imman Leyverman!

reviews.author: Tasha Mccrae
reviews.text: Brought my BMW X5 for repair after being referred by State Farm. Bloomfield Auto Body did an excellent job fixing my car. My car was returned in 1 week. I would definitely recommend this auto body shop. Excellent customer service. Thank you

reviews.author: Melissa Huguet
reviews.text: WOMEN AND YOUNG DRIVERS: AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COSTS! My car came in for a repair in the rear bumper and one of them utilized my car for god knows what. 3k miles and ran it til it reached -1687 miles of oil life in the span of a month. I have their paperwork stating the miles in and conveniently, the miles out wasn’t written in. I was observant in seeing the number on the odometer (3 thousand miles more) They refused to show me surveillance cameras to prove otherwise. They claim they don’t have them installed (even though I visibly saw ones outside). I’ve never heard of any auto body shop having no cameras. One of their workers left their clothes, countless change, 2 used water jugs and other personal belongings in my car, which they asked me to return and with good faith I returned to them. I use an EZpass and cleaned my car entirely before handing it to them, my front and back seat were dirty when I picked it up. They lied and claimed the belongings belonged to another customer. They told me that removing the battery could’ve affected the odometer and they’d call the manufacturer themselves to verify (they didn’t.) This repair was supposed to take two weeks and they used my car for a month. Two weeks into that month I came to the shop to check the progress and NOTHING was done to it. But it was certainly parked out front. They gave me the run-around for weeks and presented no care or solution to this problem. They devalued my car in adding miles and brushed me off because I’m a woman and they took advantage and took me for a fool. I’m disheartened by this situation.

reviews.author: Neil Downey
reviews.text: They did a great job and were very friendly and professional. They even helped me to get a better price on a rental car. Nora and her crew took great care of me. Thanks! Neil

reviews.author: Elizabeth Freeman
reviews.text: I visited this location in April after my vehicle had been hit during a traffic accident. Everyone in the office was friendly and professional. They explain to you what they are going to do, step by step. From the photos, to the estimate etc. When you have an accident sometimes you have to get a rental car while your vehicle is being prepared. So, it’s important to know how long the process is going to take! Bloomfield Auto body provided me with a timeline and they stuck to it! Once my car came back, they not only made it look brand new (my accident was front end, so I needed an entirely new front bumper) they cleaned the interior of my headlights. What a difference that made! They also gave my vehicle an interior and exterior wash. Essentially, they went above and beyond. I had my vehicle back in three days! Lastly, everyone in the office wore masks while engaging with me. Which was important to me during a Pandemic.

reviews.author: Jayson Despecci
reviews.text: Bloomfield auto body is the best body shop in Essex County. Nick and his staff are beyond professional and treated me like family. I came in to get a small panel that had flew off in an ice storm replaced and painted. They did phenomenal work with prepping and matching the paint on my car. They were very on point with being on time and kept there word. There prices are very fair for the quality work they do. If you are in the Bloomfield area I highly suggest you check them out you wont be disappointed.

reviews.author: Chris Medina
reviews.text: Alex did a great job facilitating the repair of my 2023 Kia after a side collision. Bloomfield auto body kept me updated on my repair throughout the whole process. Car came back brand new two weeks later! Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: David Phillips
reviews.text: Had two small issues with my cars. With the one under carriage cover, when I went in for a quote they reattached it temporarily to make it safe until the part was ordered and it could be fixed (without me asking or saying that I would use their services). They’re friendly, really professional and communicated everything really well. Can easily recommend them!

reviews.author: Eve Mont (Ev3)
reviews.text: Wow! I’m so impressed with Bloomfield Auto Body. I highly recommend them for your auto body car needs. From scheduling appointments to follow ups they are super nice and easy to work with. Very professional and excellent work quality!

reviews.author: Marino Lopez Grajales
reviews.text: Really love the way Alexander help me from the beginning until the day they gave my car back. Everybody so professional and organized. The work they did was the best I recommend Bloomfield Auto Body 100%. Thank you

reviews.author: Carolyn J
reviews.text: I had experience with Bloomfield Auto Body many years ago. I was satisfied back then and still very appreciative how well they did my car this time an excellent experience and great service.

reviews.author: Joana Oliveira
reviews.text: Excellent service! Repaired the lid in my car. Very easy to deal with. Ordered parts needed for repair. once parts came in work was completed on the same day.

reviews.author: Don Coltenback
reviews.text: Excellence best describes their service and impeccable describes their craftsmanship. That’s not even the best part. My car was detailed incredibly, looked like new when I picked it up. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Boris Levin
reviews.text: You guys did an amazing job on my 2023 Mercedes EQS. It's definitely not and easy car to fix , but Alex and Team did a phenomenal job on it! I would definitely recommend your place to my friends and colleagues. Thank you guys!

reviews.author: Jonathan Isaacs
reviews.text: The service at Bloomfield Auto Body was top notch. I was involved in a side impact and needed two new doors installed. They made the process of coordinating with my insurance (Statefarm) a breeze. One of the main things that stood out was the quality of the repair and their attention to detail. Both doors were installed and painted back to full factory spec, with the consistency of the paint finish and pin-stripes being the real game changer. When it was ready for pick up, I arrived and saw that my car was thoroughly cleaned and detailed. This was the best it looked since I drove it off the dealer lot. You can definitely trust them to get you back on the road!!

reviews.author: M Mendoza
reviews.text: Brought our car in after a rear end early December. Car was fixed well as far as we can tell (hence 2 stars for the required work that was done). Was told we would get the car back in two weeks. Car did not come back until after Christmas, in which about 100 miles were added on the odometer. The front cup holder was left with full of change (assuming for tolls) as well as an open water jug in the back seat. The back seats came back dirty as well as the cup holders in the rear center. Car is brand new and was used at their leisure during the holidays. Will not recommend or go back here.

reviews.author: Henri-Claude Bailly
reviews.text: I am a first-time client. Bloomfield Auto Body offers great customer service; the facility is impeccable; and the quality of work is excellent. I recommend them wholeheartedly.

reviews.author: Luke
reviews.text: I have no need to take my vehicles elsewhere. I’ve used these guys 3 times and I will travel long distance to do so because the customer service and work are outstanding.

reviews.author: Joe
reviews.text: Awesome service. From the office staff to the body shop repair area. They are absolute perfectionists. Special thanks to Nick and Alexander for the entire experience from beginning to end. I can't recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Nicholas Petine
reviews.text: I got into a fender bender with my recently purchased Jeep Grand Cherokee and the team at Bloomfield Auto Body did a great job fixing it. While the Jeep was there I also had an interior/exterior detail done and when I picked up Jeep it looked better then the day I bought it! The staff is extremely helpful and will answer any and all questions you may have.

reviews.author: Cindy Dubell
reviews.text: Anthony and his crew are amazing!!! My car was hit while parked, with a substantial amount of damage. Bloomfield Auto Body took complete care of my car’s repairs, and my car now looks brand new. The paint job is spectacular!!

reviews.author: Crystal Hunt
reviews.text: Bloomfield Auto body did EXCELLENT work on my Mercedes Ben ,Nick was very professional. Great cutestomer service. Sent progess updates via text and got the work done in a timely manner. My Benz look absolutely beautiful! I highly recommend this Auto body shop.

reviews.author: Jackie R
reviews.text: A branch took my side mirror off and dented the roof and side panel along the way. My insurance company suggested them, so I sent the car there. I got the car back and it looked brand new. The car had been detailed as well. The service was fast and professional. I would recommend them.

reviews.author: Keith Crosby
reviews.text: We took my wife’s truck to get repaired after it was hit while parked. Bloomfield Auto body helped us navigate the whole process including dealing with Progressive Insurance ( which was a total nightmare) They went above and beyond and my wife’s truck looks fabulous!!!!!

reviews.author: Nicole Voss
reviews.text: I would highly recommend that anyone looking for professional high quality work check this place out. My boyfriend Jose had an accident and they repaired his car in the exact time they promised. The quality was amazing and look brand new, the detailing work as well was amazing.

reviews.author: Jordan Pontell
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about Bloomfield Auto Body. The work they did on my car is not just good it’s fantastic. They dealt with my insurance company directly and held them responsible to ordering quality replacement parts. My car looks new again. I wholeheartedly recommend this shop!

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text: These gals/guys literally rebuilt my sister's first car 4 or 5 times when she was young, and each and every single time, the car looked literally brand new. That's 5 stars in my book. Their work is of extremely high quality and their customer service is top-notch. The definitive body shop in the area.

reviews.author: Michael Yip
reviews.text: My wife and I have brought both of our cars in for work and each time Bloomfield Auto Body has done a spectacular job. Excellent customer service from both Bobby and Anthony. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Fuad Dahan
reviews.text: Very professional auto shop. Their work is through, great service, they provided accurate duration to finish the work. Their shop is clean. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Yakim Abdul-Ali
reviews.text: On december the seventeenth My car was hit it look like it was ready for the junkyard. I took my car to bloomfield auto body and less than 3 weeks I got ny car back they did an incredible job you can't even tell my car was hit I will personally recommend anyone I know who need any type of body work done to their car to go to Bloomfield auto body

reviews.author: Kristen Kush
reviews.text: I just got my Subaru back from Bloomfield Auto body and it looks amazing. The repairs from my accident or taken care of with great attention to detail

reviews.author: Don Cornell
reviews.text: I have been going to Bloomfield Auto Body for about 30 years / five vehicles. They have always been professional, courteous, and informative about the work to be done.

reviews.author: Richard M.
reviews.text: Had a nasty gouge in my rear door. When I picked it up, my car looked like new! Most excellent work. They even touched up a few scratches that weren't part of the job. I couldn't be more pleased.

reviews.author: Todd Reid
reviews.text: If you take your car here make sure to put an airtag or tile in it to tracker where it is. Got our car back with 5k extra miles and clothes and change that didn't belong to us, also a boardwalk arcade card that also wasn't ours.

reviews.author: Melissa
reviews.text: Great service. Car looks beautiful after a door/dent repair. Nice staff and work done in a timely manner. They made the process so easy.

reviews.author: Chris Diaz
reviews.text: They not only handled my repairs swiftly but they are amazing people. I will be bringing my car here from now on. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

reviews.author: Miguel Chavez
reviews.text: I would recommend this body shop to anyone it’s a warm environment and they are super reliable. Any issues with your car you should definitely go there. Best customer service

reviews.author: Luis T
reviews.text: My front bumper and light got fixed and my car got washed which it needed it. All in all my car looked new and I’m satisfied with the results.

reviews.author: Tye Dheming
reviews.text: HIGHLY RECOMMEND. I dropped my Ford Fusion for repairs and Alex was super helpful throughout the entire process

reviews.author: Bee M S
reviews.text: Overrated. Prices too high labor cost itself was obsessive. Shop around. Good work is a given, there are no rewards for that. Friendly cordial but will drive the price screws to you. Visited a competitor and saved $500 on the Job.

reviews.author: Reshma Thomas
reviews.text: Great experience. Kept us updated on all the works. Friendly service. Delivered the vehicle as scheduled.

reviews.author: Austin Tannenbaum
reviews.text: Bob is a very helpful and friendly guy. Cleaned a gnarly paint scratch off my car and didn't even charge for it. I know where I'm going for all future touch ups!

reviews.author: Miabella Hernandez
reviews.text: They were the sweetest people ever. I called them about a short issue and they reassured me on everything. I believe they deserve all the business they get!

reviews.author: Michelle Vanhoven
reviews.text: This organization has my complete and utter trust with regard to my cars. Their work is excellent, and everyone who works there is helpful, professional, and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Jen
reviews.text: Writing this after having worked with Anthony my second time. I can not say enough about his professionalism and what a smooth process this was both times. So convenient having them deal directly with my insurance co. Fear not!

reviews.author: Sammy Sahyouni
reviews.text: Dropped off my audi after a crash and came back better than before. Great quality service and amazing response times

reviews.author: Olivier Bellostas
reviews.text: This body shop is the only one I use because they can get the most out of the insurance companies. The results are always beyond my expectations. Anthony is an artist. Thank you Bloomfield Auto Body.

reviews.author: Angely Melendez
reviews.text: Terrible job. Will give you the run around, use your car at their leisurely, and get your car back to you in worse condition. Stay clear of this establishment.

reviews.author: Erik Berman
reviews.text: Long Standing Bloomfield Staple. Any type of body work or insurance claims, Bring Your Car Here. Very Professional, No Hold up, they get you in and out.

reviews.author: Belinda Davalos
reviews.text: Bloomfield auto body is the place to go for any auto body work. 10 out of 10! Thank you, Alex and team.

reviews.author: Justin Murillo
reviews.text: Excellent service excellent staff made sure everything was right and went above and beyond.. definitely recommend

reviews.author: Katrina Hodges
reviews.text: I got my car fix here , received my car back my buttons on my window was broke and the window won’t go up or down came to see my car the day before everything was fine .

reviews.author: Lleana Bartomeo
reviews.text: One of the BEST experiences from start to finish!!! My car was done in the time frame they promised & customer service was EXCELLENT! Highly highly recommend

reviews.author: Matthew Barr
reviews.text: The team does a fantastic job, high attention to detail, and extremely efficient with their time. Highly recommend using Alex and team for any repair services needed - all types of cars!

reviews.author: Mladen Savicevic
reviews.text: I needed big help (I didn't know how to do it) to remove screw that broke deep inside trim. Even though they are packed with cars, owner Alex gave me experienced person that did it. Can't praise enough attitude and approach. Big recommendations!

reviews.author: Luis Miguel Zuloeta Marin
reviews.text: Great job!! They treated me wonderfully, were very understanding, and did an excellent job, thank you!

reviews.author: Omar Mercedes Cedano
reviews.text: It's an excellent place, very friendly, efficient, and helpful with whatever is needed. Thank you so much and blessings.
